notes.title: Janosik 2 is Now Steam Deck Verified! Take the Adventure Anywhere
notes.content:
Great news, adventurers! 

[b]Janosik 2 is officially Steam Deck Verified,[/b] meaning you can now experience the thrilling highland journey wherever you go. Whether you're commuting, relaxing at home, or even exploring the real Slovakian Highlands, Janosik and his friends are ready to join you whenever, and wherever.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/a54f39f366c6e9a111ec60004d6544523698fa24.png[/img]

The "Verified" status means that [b]Janosik 2[/b] is fully optimized for Steam Deck, and there’s never been a better time to dive into the action. Don't wait and grab your Deck, prepare your thumbs, and get ready to venture into the highlands!

[h3][b]Upcoming Cloud Saves Update[/b][/h3]

Lately, we've been working on enabling [b]Cloud Saves for Janosik 2[/b], so your progress could carry onto another PC, or, more importantly, your [b]Steam Deck[/b]. While we have the PC - PC Cloud Saves working, the PC - Steam Deck situation proves to be more difficult than anticipated. At first, any solution we applied caused a total save wipe, which is a no go. We've managed to get a solution that works in most cases, however, in some instances it erases the latest save point, and the game puts you back at the second most recent save point. 

We're dedicated to making Cloud Saves work as intended, but it will require a rebuilding of the game's save system. And that in turn means most solutions result in progress loss - we're working to find a solution that doesn't interfere with the save files completely, We're aiming to have this update ready and live in a couple of weeks. We'll keep you posted with any updates regarding that!

As always, if you like Janosik 2 and enjoy your adventures, share our game with your friends, or leave a review to help us reach even more players!

Until next time!

notes.title: The Power of 9: Janosik 2’s First Month
notes.content:
Hey Adventurers!

We hope you all had a chance to rest over the winter break and cranked the party meter up for New Year’s! Here’s to unforgettable gaming moments, epic adventures that would make Janosik himself proud, and a fantastic 2025.

As we reflect on the first month since [b]Janosik 2[/b] launched, one thing is clear - [b]the number 9 has been our lucky charm.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/308003a1630280d2d811346b934f316ce216c2a2.png[/img]
It all started with our release on December [b]9[/b]th. Since then, we’ve been thrilled to see a [b]9[/b]5% positive review score from players. The cherry on top? GameGrin’s Dylan Pamintuan surprised us with a glowing [b]9[/b].5/10 review - what a way to kick things off!

But the biggest "[b]9[/b]" came just before we wrapped 2024…

Just two days after launch, [b]Janosik 2[/b] was nominated for the [b]Indie of the Year Award[/b] on IndieDB, standing tall alongside [b]99[/b] other incredible indie games, including the Game of the Year nominee, [b]Balatro[/b].
We were beyond happy to be considered for the award so soon after launch, but when the final results came in, our excitement reached new heights:

[h3][b]Janosik 2 was crowned the 9th best indie game of 2024![/b][/h3]

Legends say Janosik’s strength came from his giant ancestry, but to find ourselves among the giants of the indie gaming world is an entirely different kind of achievement.

A huge thank you to everyone who voted for us in the Indie of the Year Awards. We wouldn’t be here without you. Let’s make 2025 the year of legendary Highlander adventures with [b]Janosik 2[/b]!

notes.title: Dev Update: The Art of Adventure
notes.content:
Hey, Adventurers!

In the last Dev Update we’ve talked about music being your companion throughout the game, anywhere you go, the music is there. Today we’d like to share more details about the pixel-art and cinematics that are present in [b]Janosik 2[/b], and spill some tea about their creation process.

[h3][b]Creating Sprites and Backgrounds[/b][/h3]

[b]Janosik 2[/b]’s visuals are a love letter to classic games, combining retro pixel art with fresh animation techniques. The game’s sprites and backgrounds were drawn by hand, one pixel at a time in Aseprite. To keep the vibe of old-school platformer, Marcin used a limited color palette and focused on clean, and readable designs. The final pixel-art is simple, yet vibrant and expressive, mixing modern animations with retro charm.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/e5efd1527c9c0f2b2cf3c74074339ef5dccdbf3d.png[/img]

[h3][b]Rotoscoping Magic[/b][/h3]

All cinematic sequences in [b]Janosik 2[/b] were created using the rotoscoping technique. This process involved recording short video clips of desired animation sequences, which were later redrawn frame-by-frame in Aseprite. Every movement - from running and weapons swings, to more complex gestures - was first recorded to make the animations as precise as possible. By doing so, Marcin was able to achieve smooth and lifelike animations, which are hard to achieve while drawing pixel art. It’s a bit like creating a flipbook, but with each pixel carefully placed in the sequence.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/a1f0da0ad26f599f2bf28d253bb26fab6417e30a.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/e387d2e9d5d68f9d6c2d69bc41949b6f16f28b1c.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/00a6a1a073e0196a21a18120b91c7b1efa63a450.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/9397b866aea2d8f409ea52d74fc770cd44acda2a.gif[/img]

Thanks to rotoscoping and hand-drawing all pixel art,[b] Janosik 2[/b] is a game that feels both familiar and fresh, combining smooth, lifelike animations with the charm of classic pixel art. Every scene, movement, and background element was crafted with a dedication to detail and an appreciation for the art form, creating an experience that, we hope, will appeal to fans of pixel art and newcomers alike.

[h3][b]Wishlist Janosik 2[/b][/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1640400/Janosik_2/

[h3][b]A Glimpse into Western Fashion[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/b0bb339abbbc34aaf11ec57684f5c5362c0b7681.png[/img]

 For those curious about the pixel art in a distinctly different setting check out [b]Undead West[/b]—a gritty, black-and-white pixel adventure set in a haunted Wild West. Where [b]Janosik 2[/b] brings bright colors and lifelike rotoscoped animation, Undead West goes old-school with a bold, 2-bit palette inspired by classics like [i]Downwell[/i] and [i]Minit[/i]. It’s a different kind of retro: stark, shadowy, and packed with western action.

notes.title: Dev Update: The Sound of Highlands

Hey adventurers,

We've talked about Janosik's companions in the previous Dev Updates, but there is something else that will accompany you during your journey into the Highlands - the music!

The man behind Janosik 2's soundtrack is Juhani Junkala, a talented composer from Helsinki, Finland. We first came across Juhani's work on OpenGameArt, where several of his tracks immediately caught our attention. In fact, we liked them so much we reached out to him with a proposal to collaborate on Janosik 2. Thankfully, he was up for it, and that's how the music for the game came to life!

While Juhani has since stepped away from creating music for games, we’re thrilled that Janosik 2 was one of his last stops in the industry. His work quite literally puts the “fairy” in our tale, bringing the magic of the game to life in ways we couldn’t have expected.

When it comes to inspiration, we wanted the soundtrack to have the same folk-inspired atmosphere that we had in the original Janosik. The goal was to stay true to that vibe while evolving the sound to match the new gameplay in Janosik 2.

A lot of sound effects you'll hear in the game, from the sound of coins being picked up, to punches, various effects, and even the character voices and... grunts - all of these were recorded by none other than Marcin "Onix" himself. notes.title: Dev Update: Embracing the Myths and Legends in Janosik 2
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

As we're getting closer and closer to the release of [b]Janosik 2[/b], we're happy to share more about the world we're building and the legends that inspire it. Aside from being an action-packed adventure, the journey you will soon embark on leads straight into the heart of Slavic folklore, where the history and myths intertwine.

Let's start with the man himself - Janosik was a real historical figure who lived in what is now Slovakia at the turn of the 17th and 18th centuries. Like a Slavic Robin Hood, Janosik was known for helping the poor by robbing the rich. As a leader of a band of outlaws – he became famous for his bravery and cunning.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/3387cc04a7c3ce46311d34a38786912fffcf0b53.gif[/img]

However, [b]Janosik 2[/b] draws inspiration from folk legends surrounding Janosik, rather than true story of his life. In these stories, Janosik has often been portrayed with superhuman abilities – bullets couldn’t harm him, and he could leap great distances thanks to his shepherd's axe. Always one step ahead of his enemies, Janosik’s journey in the game will lead him to face not only human foes but also legendary creatures like witches, devils, and vampires.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/bfcc10e9f7c8060363d772252c416d8f6d78dd57.png[/img]

You already know that Janosik isn't fighting alone—he's joined by Bogdan, the Werewolf, and Hugo, the (vegetarian) Vampire. Together, they stand against the resilient forces of the nefarious Countess Bathory and work to save Janosik's beloved, Janka, from the grasp of Baron de Blonde. As a formidable team, they will face countless challenges, combining their unique strengths and abilities to overcome the dark threats that lie ahead.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/e3e400571f11140ce712f3c75e82cb455406bdbb.gif[/img]

Speaking of Countess Bathory, she is the primary antagonist in the game, drawing inspiration from the historical figure Elizabeth Báthory, who was rumored to be a vampire. notes.title: Dev Update: Trouble in the Highlands
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

During your adventures in the Highlands, you will face a vast array of enemies, each more dangerous than the last. As you venture through treacherous mountains, dense forests, and dark dungeons, Janosik’s journey is filled with fearsome bosses, Countess Bathory’s goons, wild animals, and creatures straight from myths and legends, all determined to stop the fearless Highlander in his tracks. From cunning bandits to ancient spirits, every encounter is designed to challenge not just your combat skills, but your ability to adapt and strategize on the fly and think creatively. The toughest of your adversaries will often require you to switch characters and use their abilities in the right order to bring them down.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/ac22bd5a49b18150de0ea285a5991b1a5e349469.gif[/img]

You meet the Crossbow Man early in the game. This enemy is much tougher and more dangerous than regular goons. He shoots two arrows when he notices you, but the good thing is that you’ll already be able to switch to Bogdan and block these attacks. Later in the game, you can also get a nice upgrade to reflect his arrows and use them against the Crossbow Man. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/09a1ac97167bd441e1574d128e7760414397bf73.gif[/img]

Rondel is the first boss in Janosik 2. He’s not a good man (obviously) and treats people really badly. When you first encounter Rondel, Janosik has no weapons. This is where a little creativity and use of the environment will come in handy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/4b2c185594a636cfd6b7b73ce9008dd5bea19803.gif[/img]

A maniac in a rabbit mask. A giant at least 10 feet tall, mumbling something about sacrificing all the time. He’s a very powerful enemy that you’ll meet later in the game. Jan Rabbit has different types of attacks, like throwing hammers, causing huge stones to fall from the sky, and… well, you’ll see. We don’t want to spoil it for you. 

As the dust settles after each hard-fought battle in Janosik 2, you’ll realize that every clash with an enemy sharpens your skills. From minor threats to towering bosses, each encounter is a significant part of your journey. The challenges you face are more than just obstacles; they are parts of a story, and each triumph brings you closer to rescuing Janosik and his friends from Countess Bathory’s grasp.

Have fun!

notes.title: Dev Update: Fellowship of the Village
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

The Highlands are a beautiful place, flourishing with flowers, trees, and all kinds of plants, A sight to behold, you might say. Unfortunately, the presence of Countess Bathory and her goons makes them a really dangerous place. Janosik found this out the hard way having gotten captured and thrown into a dungeon when trying to make it to his date.

To help you survive the Highlands, and deal with the Countess' army, kind people around the village will offer to sell a variety of items that will surely boost your combat prowess, or make exploration easier. These items are not required to progress further in the game, but will surely come in handy when you want to become a treasure hunter, or explore all of the Highlands.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/19c1e022e2ed4e9e109341e1b0929b145a998aeb.jpg[/img]

[b]Map of the Village[/b] - Allows you to check your surroundings, and see where all cool people, including vendors, and certain people of interest, hang out.

[b]Golden Compass[/b] - The magical compass unveils the location of treasures scattered around the levels on the map. Once you purchase this, all maps found in the future will have the treasure markers on them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/e284fa7bd2a996fb23ef9937e9052f552706c1b7.png[/img]

[b]Harpoon[/b] - Janosik and his friends surely are great swimmers, but, unfortunately, they didn't learn how to use their weapons underwater. Instead, they rely on the Harpoon, which makes the underwater combat possible. Another advantage of buying this weapon is the ability to break rocks underwater to reveal hidden passages.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/d3d9139aa6cad1a24c5a04e1784aabb121e78d14.gif[/img]

[b]Eel Ring[/b] - Janosik once had the Sturgeon Ring in his possession. It allowed him to breathe underwater, Unfortunately, he lost it while he was taking a bath... Thankfully, the Witch at the Village has a similar trinket in her collection. The Magical Eel Ring will also let Janosik and his friends breathe underwater, hopefully they don't lose it this time.

[b]Ring of Dexterity[/b] - Janosik would make a great Gymnast, as he has honed the ability to roll around to perfection. Ring of Dexterity is an icing to the cake, as it allows Janosik to dodge enemy projectiles, while rolling.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/996875c9e717c23bc796a64853fa5e1d5832b399.gif[/img]

[b]Potions[/b] - The witch is carefully brewing Potions in her hut, and offers them to people in need. These magical concoctions will completely refill your Health. Make sure to always have some tied to your belt, they will come in handy in the midst of battle.

To tackle the dangers of the Highlands, preparation is key. Whether you’re searching for hidden treasures, battling underwater foes, or when bullets are flying right at you, the right tools will make all the difference. Equip yourself wisely and take advantage of the items offered by friendly villagers. With their help, you'll be ready to face the challenges ahead, uncover the secrets of this treacherous land, and take fight directly to Countess Bathory.

Make sure to join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/Nx6CmMNgrj]Discord server[/url] to join our Community and stay up to date with all things Janosik. 

Until next time!

notes.title: Dev Update: Lord of the Blings
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

In most stories, heroes are rarely after riches and glory, it’s rather up adventurers’ alley. But who said you can't be both... Let’s be real - [b]who doesn’t love a little bling[/b]? In Janosik 2, the heroes can certainly put the gold they find to good use. The world of Janosik 2 is filled with golden coins, hefty treasures, and precious gemstones waiting to be collected. These, however, are not just a collector’s delight. During your adventure, you will encounter characters who possess powerful items and are happy to trade them if your coin pouch jingles loud enough.

[h3][b]Riches beyond compare[/b][/h3]

When exploring the picturesque highlands, grim dungeons, twisted corridors, and even underwater, you will often stumble upon shiny treasure. Each collectible adds a certain amount of gold to your pouch upon pickup. Here’s a rundown of how much they are worth:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/dd773d85951a3c5a57c9d99f72b659204547b48c.png[/img] [b]Coin[/b]: 1 gold
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/c6d2d8b18df594647d7679593a534359d01c97d5.png[/img] [b]Emerald[/b]: 10 gold
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/ce9cd19b54577cbee5ad6ea47b871c7285ebdfa5.png[/img] [b]Ruby[/b]: 12 gold
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/49789e4b78c2a5dff4152e5bd41e5b806d2d8927.png[/img] [b]Pink Gemstone[/b]: 14 gold
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/d79f5058e009bdc78e1adeda6b20be8b7f21ea97.png[/img] [b]Topaz[/b]: 15 gold
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/a0874a94ee657fa6c3aec587f91ce3d5f8e0fd36.png[/img] [b]Diamond[/b]: 18 gold
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/8f0b4114a497146464afc26ef36d8eaa1de7eaa8.png[/img] [b]Ring[/b]: 20 gold
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/792c4c3b1d187a163cfc1b6f06999d4bfaf2fc87.png[/img] [b]Pearl[/b]: 25 gold
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/947a0046d155bc67bb41ea293a104b0cff347124.png[/img] [b]Bag of Gold[/b]: 35 gold
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/70a99d3aa1c4bfdc0b7f2488c22d546031e07b94.png[/img] [b]Chest (Wooden)[/b]: 50 gold
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/9d9977767c3a0e41bed79d01d680a820000f5b5c.png[/img] [b]Chest (Golden)[/b]: 100 gold
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/15fbdc83e7f137caca2de12a27eb22975d4cdb63.png[/img] [b]Pot of Gold[/b]: 150 gold
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/3e8443d287a4cd4cfa2c9d00e4aa6f6947e1592b.png[/img] [b]Crown[/b]: 500 gold

The rarer the treasure, the more it’s worth. But the real worth of the gold is defined by the items you can buy with it.

[h3][b]A journey worth every coin[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/2c946881121e012477b93b908547deb77bdeda16.jpg[/img]
You will encounter various characters on your journey. Some of them inhabit a nearby village you can visit, while others can be encountered around the levels. There is a clear distinction between them. The characters you meet outside of the village will offer you items necessary to progress further. Some of them include:[list]
[*] [b]Double Jump Boots
[*] Shepherd’s Axe
[*] Repeater Beater
[*] Rock Climbing Boots
[*] Electro Shock[/b][/list]Items acquired from the encountered characters will be crucial, as they enable you to overcome certain obstacles or reach otherwise inaccessible places.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/c97dbea39337a7a723ff41b55cbc02f441fb0834.gif[/img]
You will also be able to purchase items in the village - they are not required to progress in the story, but it doesn’t mean they are any less useful. Everyone in the village has heard the tales of brave Janosik, and his fearless companions, and wants to help them. The blacksmith is eager to upgrade your weapons, the inventor will be able to increase the size of your ammo pouch, while villagers are willing to sell a variety of items (for a fair price, of course), such as: [list]
[*] [b]Map of the Village
[*] Ring of Dexterity
[*] Golden Compass
[*] Eel Ring
[*] Harpoon
[*] Potions[/b][/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/d047129cc6c599653e0fb8547086864f4d7d18ce.jpg[/img]
You might also be interested in obtaining Treasure Maps, which indicate how many treasures are left on the level, and where to find them. Those are just a few examples, and the rest will be up to you to discover.

While working on Janosik 2, one of our goals was to make the exploration rewarding, and inviting. If we were to give out a single piece of advice, it would be to check every nook and cranny, as it may hold a treasure hoard. As you gather gold, think of it not just as a currency, or a collectible required for an achievement, but rather as a tool to overcome challenges, and welcome new possibilities. 

You will be able to start your journey in Janosik 2 soon, and when you do, remember to keep your eyes peeled and your gold pouch filled, as every treasure you find and deal you make, will bring you closer to the glory you seek, and the victories you’ll take.

[h3][b]Upcoming Playtest[/b][/h3]
Staying on the topic of being able to give Janosik 2 a try soon... 

[b]Over the next weekend (September 5 - September 9)[/b] we will be playtesting Janosik 2, along with another upcoming retro title - Undead West a western-themed bullet hell roguelite, in which you’re on a quest for vengeance against the mysterious Man in Red. 
Check it out on Steam:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2527880/Undead_West/

notes.title: Janosik 2: Heroes Armed and Ready
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

In the previous devlog, we dipped our toes in the topics of world design and the challenges you’ll face in Janosik 2. This time we’d like to introduce you to weapons and abilities at our heroes’ disposal. 

[h2][b]MEET THE HEROES AND THEIR ARSENAL[/b][/h2]

Each hero in Janosik 2 brings something unique to the table, from powerful weapons to special abilities that can shift the way you approach certain enemies, or even move through the levels. Since you can switch characters on the fly, we’ve made sure that traversing the levels and certain boss fights will sometimes require a bit of thought and smart character selection to progress further.

[h3][b]Janosik the Highlander[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/3387cc04a7c3ce46311d34a38786912fffcf0b53.gif[/img]
[b]Weapon 1 - Sword[/b]: A trusty ol’ blade well suited for melee combat
[b]Weapon 2 - Pistols[/b]: Perfect for ranged attacks. When you can’t get close, just blast enemies from afar
[b]Special Item - Shepherd’s Axe[/b]: A unique tool that can be thrown and stuck in a wall, enabling Janosik to reach high areas that are otherwise hard to access
[b]Special Ability - Roll[/b]: Allows Janosik to dodge traps and enemy attacks

[h3][b]Bogdan the Werewolf[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/dd34b37317c5c4b91dda18225bb5234da3a4aa4a.gif[/img]
[b]Weapon 1 - Repeater Beater[/b]: A useful mace for melee… and ranged combat. The Repeater Beater can also be thrown like a boomerang 
[b]Weapon 2 - Bombs[/b]: Powerful explosives that can be placed and detonated manually, or struck with the Repeater Beater for a mid-air explosion 
[b]Special Item - Shield[/b]: A defensive tool that blocks enemy attacks and projectiles 
[b]Special Ability - Pushing Stones[/b]: The werewolf brawn allows Bogdan to move heavy stones, opening new pathways and solving environmental puzzles

[h3][b]Janka the Maiden[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/15745349657e37ec270694d6984a65e827c6b84f.gif[/img]
[b]Weapon 1 - Magic Lamp[/b]: A mystical lantern that illuminates dark areas and can light unlit torches 
[b]Weapon 2 - Freezing Power[/b]: A magical ability that fires an icy projectile, freezing enemies in place
[b]Special Item - Rock Climbing Boots[/b]: A special pair of boots that allow Janka to cling to walls, making vertical exploration that much easier
[b]Special Ability - Air Dash[/b]: A dynamic move that allows Janka to dash through the air

[h3][b]Hugo the Vampire[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/a3c7c3b82988d527d8ceba1ca8168a82884afbd5.gif[/img]
[b]Weapon 1 - Whip[/b]: A fitting weapon for medium-range combat, perfect for keeping enemies at a safe distance while dealing solid damage
[b]Weapon 2 - Bow[/b]: A reliable ranged weapon for our vegetarian vampire
[b]Special Item - Electro Shock[/b]: A powerful item that can disable electric traps and shock enemies. Quite literally
[b]Special Ability - Cape[/b]: Thanks to his cape, Hugo can glide through the air, reducing fall speed and making air control a… breeze

[h3][b]SHARED ABILITIES AND WEAPONS[/b][/h3]

[b]Double Jump Boots[/b]: Specialized boots that grant the ability to double jump, enhancing our heroes’ mobility and making it easier (or possible) to reach some places.
[b]Harpoon[/b]: A versatile weapon that allows characters to attack enemies underwater, ensuring they can fare in every environment.

Thanks for tagging along on our little tour of our heroes’ wardrobes… or rather armories. Whether you’re into sword-swinging, spell-slinging, or just tossing bombs around, we’ve got you covered. The best way to outwit de Blonde’s goons is to get creative and use every tool and weapon at your disposal. Keep your swords sharp, your boots laced, and your bombs ready to… well… go boom. Thanks for reading and see you in the next one.

notes.title: Janosik 2 at Steam Next Fest 2024
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/aadc94770fc5488de95ffc91f93ffd3aeec687ec.png[/img]

Hey, everyone!

We’re proud to let you all know that Janosik 2 is a part of the Steam Next Fest June 2024! Here’s a short info on what to expect from the traditional shepherd’s hat-wearing brave who joins forces with a reluctant vampire and burly werewolf to conquer evil minions of nefarious Countess Bathory and her fairy tale minions. 

Janosik 2 picks right after the events of the first game, which is available for free [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1412170/Janosik__Highlander_Precision_Platformer/]here on Steam[/url]. [b]In the updated demo you can check out the first 3 out of 24 maps of Janosik 2 and get a taste of what’s ahead![/b]

Let’s step into this mythic pixel art land of the Slavic Highlander and see what challenges, threats, and enemies you can expect in Janosik 2!

[h3][b]Old-school precision platforming[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/3b820ca9c57ece73555251595605d644e4e9b59b.gif[/img]

Janosik 2 will require good management of your speed, momentum, and jumping distance, as well as good reaction time. A single mistake can lead to falling into a trap or not reaching a desired spot. A lot of platforming elements are in constant motion so it adds another layer of complexity to traversing the levels. 

The encounters in Janosik 2 are varied and require a good deal of bold moves and quick decision-making. You will frequently need to show your platforming prowess to collect shiny treasures and liberate imprisoned companions. You’ll need to keep your eyes peeled at all times because the danger can come from every direction. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/c4e40560d5ce89990d1de15f47b31bfe4a974379.gif[/img]

To make the challenge of Janosik 2 more manageable, we've added a lot of save points throughout the levels to make the backtracking easier.

During your journey, you will find golden coins, pricy jewels, and hefty treasures scattered around the landscapes. Make sure to fill your gold sack with coins, as some vendors have put a price on their prized possessions such as a throwable Shepherd’s Axe, a Bow, a Shield, or an heirloom that lets you freeze your foes in air. Gold can also help you reach some parts of the levels by unlocking passages when interacting with NPCs or fairy tale wonders like a wishing well. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/6a14aaa0b5e70763cd4d29cce5dc67883b5e5e2a.gif[/img]

Janosik 2 will let you explore the beautiful Slavic landscapes in their fullness as some parts of the world are interconnected by doors and passages, closed when approached for the first time. You’ll need to keep playing to see how deep the rabbit hole goes.

[h3][b]Threats on your way[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/de13be1bec522aed490c5c39d4ba284cc10bb807.gif[/img]

During your adventure, you will face not-so-friendly dogs wandering around, rats lurking in the underground tunnels, nasty fish with sharp teeth hunting underwater, venomous spiders in dungeons and caves, and more. You will also fight many human enemies like the soldiers of the nefarious Countess Bathory, and her sidekick, de Blonde.

In addition to “living” foes, there are also plenty of traps and deadly spots along the way. You’ll need to keep an eye out on all sorts of spikes coming from walls, ceilings, and floors, huge boulders dropping from the ceiling while you rush through corridors, fireball-spitting gargoyles, the shaky and crumbling floor, disappearing platforms, or spider webs that will slow you down a bunch. not to mention that, sometimes, the floor obviously is lava ;) 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/5ce6211aa1d16f6c27bc3461d5916e74170588ee.gif[/img]

Underwater exploration will not be easy, as you will encounter various obstacles, menacing creatures, and need to manage the oxygen supply. Collect air bubbles floating nearby to make sure you can reach the surface safely or take a risk diving deeper to grab precious trinkets. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/23ad9876ec3cd9720ba4bbb055155dd916e5b166.gif[/img]

Of course, sometimes you can take it slow and beat some parts of the levels carefully. On the other hand, many sequences combining enemies and obstacles will require constant movement. But you will learn all that soon enough.

We’re planning a Janosik-packed summer this year, so wishlist and follow the game to stay up to date with all the news. We have a lot of awesome stuff to share in the coming weeks, starting with a Next Fest Demo!

On that note, we’d like to wish you a happy Steam Next Fest, as it is truly a time like no other. There are so many wonderful demos to check out, and we hope Janosik 2 will be on your list of demos to play. 

[b]Enjoy, and see you next time![/b]

If you’d like to jump into the mythical world of Janosik before the sequel releases, check out the first game for free!

notes.title: Janosik 2 Dev Update #2 - The rocks keep rolling, rolling, rolling…
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We thought we’d squeeze in a fresh round of [b]Janosik 2[/b] news before the Holidays. Let’s dive in!

First up, we’re working on an [b]Indiana Jones-style level[/b], where Janka has to run away from a giant boulder. It’s a classic scene from some of our favorite movies that we hope to bring you lots of fun. Don’t look back (or rather - on the left) and run as fast as you can!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/347b8d8027a82752d01d9bf1cbdb657fa0d5cd7d.gif[/img]

While we’re on the topic of rocks, we’ve added a new boss to the game, we’re calling him the [b]Rolling Stone[/b] because it’s a rock golem that can turn into a ball of stone and... roll. Now that we’re writing this update, we’re realizing how rocky this joke is…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/ca949c68f031b6cd20a8308aa9f761e72af176d8.gif[/img]

So what else is made of stone? Hmm… walls! What can you do with walls? Climb them! [b]Wall climbing[/b] is the newest way to move across levels in Janosik 2. It creates a ton of design possibilities and brings a new dynamic to the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/e012d8def0e2d7750749be3c1f66be8f0cad780d.gif[/img]

In the last update, we’ve introduced [b]Parallax Layers[/b] which add the depth effect by having multiple background images move at different speeds. Keep an eye on the gates in the background… which are also made of stone…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/f0ee25ecfc36f1054562faa8e4dad97546e7bd41.gif[/img]

That’s all for this [b]Dev Update[/b]. Remember to follow us on Steam and let us know what you think about the game. We also hope to see you on our [url=https://discord.gg/ensxn8yTvd]official Discord[/url].

See you next time!

notes.title: Janosik 2 Dev Update #1 - To the Dark Forest and beyond
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Now that you can check the demo for [b]Janosik 2[/b], we really wanted to let you know about the recent progress on the game. We also intend to make these updates more frequent.

Let’s dive in!

Over the last few months, we’ve been working on [b]Act 2 of Janosik 2[/b]. Our three main heroes (highlander Janosik, Bogdan the Werewolf, and the Vampire) will rest for a bit, while this part of the story focuses on [b]Janka[/b], Janosik’s girlfriend, as she explores some dark and mysterious areas. Thankfully, Janka has some unique abilities to deal with the obstacles she faces.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/60d8104b2f218458ed9bd4bd68359ca2cd4e4f4d.gif[/img]

For starters, Janka can light up small areas of the map for a short time thanks to her lantern. This will come in handy in the [b]Very Dark Caves[/b] area, where the lantern will be your only source of light. Without the lantern, you won’t be able to see obstacles, which should make these levels pretty challenging and exciting.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/93a72a1e2dfa699c229783c201b22f6a2d081311.gif[/img]

Once you get out of the caves, [b]The Dark Forest[/b] will be the second area you’ll visit as Janka. It is less dark than the caves, but shouldn’t be a walk in the park. It’s full of monsters, dangerous chasms, and a variety of traps. So step carefully.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/cee00c5a592b197348d3976cb4522795b148b7f4.gif[/img]

Next, you’ll find yourself in the [b]Upside Down[/b], where you’ll learn that Janka’s lantern isn’t her only special ability. The [b]mirrors[/b] are the second new gameplay mechanic we’re introducing in Act 2. Touching a mirror turns Janka’s gravity upside down, allowing her to walk on a ceiling as if it was the floor. This can seem trippy and confusing at first but you’ll get around to beating those areas. Eventually. 

The fourth area of Act 2, [b]The Mysterious Mountain[/b], isn’t ready yet. And we don’t want to spoil it. Let’s just say that Janka may need some help from her boyfriend...

Aside from Act 2, we’ve been working on some general improvements. We’ve also been recently testing [b]parallax layers[/b], and the results are promising. Parallax layering creates the depth effect by having multiple background layers moving at different speeds. Keep an eye on the forest in the background and see for yourself!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/bc06291c4d50db447d81ea2326a9241c1356c0bf.gif[/img]

And finally, [b]Juhani Junkala[/b], the composer of Janosik 2’s soundtrack has finished working on the music for the main menu and you can listen to it below!

[previewyoutube=Mtk604FMTcw;full][/previewyoutube]

That’s all for this Dev Update. Let us know what you think about new features on the Steam forum or our [url=https://discord.gg/ensxn8yTvd]Retrovibe Discord[/url].

Remember to follow Janosik 2 here on Steam, wishlist the game, and tell your friends.

See you next time!
